findings.evidence: cleanup sets entry[forced_KILL] on the transient active row, closes the log and clears active. The durable report phases arm row is a separate dict, so END omits the forced-kill flag and no unrecorded-inflight warning is set for a successful KILL. Last saved child counters can predate actual work.

findings.title: Preserve forced termination in durable terminal accounting

findings.evidence: A reaped child is removed from active before require(code==0). If it failed, its RESULT receipt and counters never reach phases; all_actual_costs is assembled only after all phases PASS. Cleanup therefore cannot recover this already-removed child.
findings.requested_change: Record terminal or last-observed RESULT authority and partial costs for every child, including failed/interrupted ones, before raising or removing active. Missing/stale terminal evidence must be explicitly incomplete.
findings.title: Retain failed child receipts and partial costs before rejecting the phase
